A success guard around shared accesses prevents that failure-path race. A signal handler calling a non-async-signal-safe mutex function can deadlock (CWE-479/833); that alone is not evidence of concurrent unprotected accesses. Invalid unlock and cancellation cleanup are separate issues unless an actual conflicting-access path is demonstrated.
- ownership: For CWE-401 track each allocation identity through aliases, reassignments, swaps, helpers, return paths and loops. A free of a different allocation is not a release of the original. Do not conflate a null dereference, double free or use-after-free with a leak.
